d:
Bina karaee-kapre ke halvaee jaisi krispi imarti sirph ₹2 men
Appe mold men imarti banane ka sikret tarika — aadhe kap dal se 50 imarti!
Pitri paksh men gay, kauve ya pandit ji ko khilane ke lie parphekt bhog resipi.
appe mold men bina karaee-kapre ke imarti banana sikhen
dal phentne aur parphekt chashni banane ki 3 sikret triks
pitri paksh bhog ke lie kyut aur chhoti saiz imarti
aadhe kap dal se 50 imarti — bajat phrendli resipi
Comment karen — imarti aap kise khilate hain, gay, kauve ya pandit ji ko?
